settings.heading: You Can't Print Depth.
settings.text:
Pick up a printed flag and you feel a board. Pick up a carved one and you feel ridges, grain, and weight.

Every flag we sell is carved from solid wood and finished by hand in small batches — the ripple, the feathers, the stars all sit in real relief, so no two are ever exactly alike.

We check every piece before it ships. If yours arrives less than perfect, we replace it free.
